engraved.template:
The first attached image is the restaurant's printed drink menu. Match the look of ITS illustrations exactly: the deep-green engraved palm fronds in the top corners, the sepia Havana Capitolio and the dark vintage car in the header, the red and pink hibiscus with green leaves in the bottom corners, and the cocktail glasses on the Happy Hour panel.
The second attached image is the approved style anchor for this set: match its outline weight, hatching and colouring treatment.
Draw: [SUBJECT].
Style: vintage engraved illustration printed in colour, like a 1950s Havana cigar-box label or travel poster. Dark brown-black engraved outlines with fine etched hatching and crosshatch shading, filled with flat, slightly muted vintage print colours. Palette: [PALETTE]. Keep colours warm and slightly desaturated, never neon, never glossy or photographic.
Background: flat pure white (#FFFFFF), no paper texture, no cast shadow on the ground, no vignette.
Composition: one isolated subject, centered, with a generous empty white margin on every side, nothing touching the edges.
Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, borders or frames.
